Collapse and expand it to try again." in place of its lines."
observed: Set up: open A/R Aging Detail (as of 11/11/2026, "Current" has 15 lines) and switch the network off.
You see: the bucket opens empty - no lines and no message - and stays that way (watched 40 seconds, three tries). The bucket's lines did try to load and failed.
The test says the bucket shows "Something went wrong loading this bucket. Collapse and expand it to try again." in place of its lines.
For the developer: when the same load fails while the computer is online, the message does appear - it is missing only when the computer is offline.
